title: One work's time limits, money figures and named authorities
description: An INDEX, not an answer: every row names the unit it came from and quotes the words it was read out of, because a number lifted out of its provision is exactly the kind of fact somebody acts on and gets wrong. Written by scripts/library-extracts.mjs from src/lib/library/quickref.ts, the same module that runs over a reader's own added document.

counts.description: Per kind, so the work page can label its three tabs without loading the rows.

value.description: The matched words, exactly as the provision writes them.

sortKey.description: What the table sorts by: days for a time limit, rupees for a figure, the lower-cased phrase for an authority. A period and a figure are not comparable, which is why the tables are separate.

verify.description: True where the extraction is less certain — a period with no deadline lead-in ("a term of five years" is not a time limit), or a figure written in words.
